translations.web: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
translations.bsb: Immediately her bleeding stopped, and she sensed in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
translations.kjv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.
translations.asv: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of her plague.
